title: Scaffolded Practice with Immediate Feedback
description: Break complex problems into smaller, sequenced steps with guided feedback at each stage.

actions.label: Worked Examples Packet
actions.description: Provide 3–5 fully worked examples that model the target skill step by step.

actions.label: Guided Practice Problems
actions.description: Assign 5 practice problems with hints enabled. Remove scaffolding gradually.

actions.label: Exit Ticket
actions.description: 3-question formative check to confirm prerequisite understanding before moving on.
